nom: TONYMOLY Mask Melt Collagen + Peptide Overnight Hydrogel Mask

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the mask delivers strong moisture and leaves skin looking vibrant and youthful, calling it a good match for dry skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation and good hydration, while others describe alarming redness, heat, or a hot rash lasting up to 24 hours after use.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 40s with rosacea and one starting to notice first signs of aging report firming and plumping effects with no redness or irritation.

concerns.aging: Two reviewers noting early signs of aging or being over 40 report their skin looked firmer and plumper, though one specifies it is not a fix for deep wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across skin types, describe the mask as strongly hydrating, leaving skin soft, dewy, or plump; no reviewer disputes its moisturizing effect.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports no redness or irritation the next day, but two other reviewers, including one with sensitive skin, report the mask caused red, hot skin or a rash lasting close to 24 hours.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes calm, relaxed skin immediately after application with no mention of barrier issues.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with dark spots reports no irritation or new redness after use, though no one reports a change in spot appearance.
concerns.blemishes: No reviewer reports breakouts caused by the mask, though one describes a rash and another redness that could be mistaken for a reaction.
concerns.oiliness: No reviews address oily skin or oil control.

aspects.libelle: Fits and adheres to face well
Mask slips or falls off face
Arrived torn or damaged in packaging

extraits.texte: Used this face mask for the good 3 hours it recommends, you can use it overnight but since I toss and turn in my sleep I didn't want to risk waking up with it off my face. When I woke up today I noticed that it left my face feeling super hot and red. I have sensitive skin and a ton of allergies but I don't have problems with the other 15-30 minute face masks from this brand. Almost 24 hours in and the redness and heat hasn't cleared. I wouldn't recommend this especially if you have an important event the next day. For now I'm not using any makeup or doing a skin care routine until it clears up because I don't want to risk irritating my skin even more. On the upside the face mask does work even with these issues, it left my skin feeling hydrated but I would still be cautious buying it.

I honestly loved this gifted by Tony Moly mask! It has that signature Tony Moly spa-like feel, but what really stood out was how soft and hydrated my skin felt afterward. The "melt" texture is super satisfying, it adheres nicely and doesn't slip around like some sheet masks. When I removed it, my skin looked fresh and dewy without feeling sticky or heavy. It gave me that healthy glow that makes you want to skip foundation the next morning. Perfect for when your skin needs a reset after a long week or a night out. I have sensitive skin with some dark spots, and it didn't irritate or cause redness at all. Highly recommend if you're looking for an affordable, quick glow-up mask that actually delivers.

Never been a huge fan of Tony Moly but i bought a few of these masks to see if they compared to the more expensive brands and was blown away. Im 28 and starting to see my first signs of skin aging. This mask made my skin look the best it has in years after wearing it for a few hours. I now use one a week and the price point is such a bonus. I never write reviews but im so in love with how plump, hydrated, and glowy my skin looks! The pink collagen mask is my favorite. I also have oretty sensitive skin and this hasnt irritated me at all. I recommend finishing up with the la roche posay cica blast b3 barrier repair cream. Thank me later!

extraits.titre: I wholeheartedly recommend this to EVERYONE over 40
extraits.texte: Left it on for 2 hrs only. My skin felt hydrated, refreshed, soft and - most importantly for Rosacea sufferers, no redness, no irritation, or itching, and the next day no bumps! If i had time to use this every day i would! i use them once a week now!

extraits.titre: The perfect mask for dry skin!
extraits.texte: So I've been using TONYMOLY skincare for a while now and I love their products, so I couldn't wait to try their overnight mask and it did not disappoint! I was gifted by TONYMOLY to try their Mask Melt Hydrogel Mask and it was such a great experience. Firstly, I loved how soothing and cool the mask felt on my skin. Almost instantly, my skin felt calm and relaxed. My skin also felt incredibly hydrated and moisturized. This is definitely a great mask for people with dry skin like myself as it provides so much moisture to the skin. I absolute loved how great my skin looked after applying the mask. My skin looked vibrant and youthful, and my pores were virtually non existent. Overall, the Mask Melt Overnight Hydrogel Mask is now a new favorite mask for me and I couldn't recommend it more!

The best mask ever!! I love TonyMoly as a brand and I feel they make great accessible skincare. This mask left my skin incredibly glowy as I do tend to have dry skin. k-beauty is incredible and I can't wait to try more masks from this line. I also love the material of these masks, it feels so nice on the skin. I love that it's pink and comes in two parts! Complimentary from TonyMoly.

On the plus side, this is a very hydrating mask. It is literally a mask that sicks on to your face and it stays in place quite well.You don't have to lay down to keep it from falling off. It applied easily and adheres well. What I didn't care for are the instructions to wear this for 3+ hours. You can wear it overnight, but that would require you to pretty much lay on your back which doesn't work for me. However, I did wear it for the 3 hours and while it appears to have nicely absorbed into my skin, there are so many other hydrating mask options that I wouldn't buy this again, but find something a bit more practical and not such a commitment!
